description: Find fashion products similar to a given product on Realry.com. Useful for "show me more like this" or "find alternatives" requests. Use the Product ID from search_products results.

country.description: Two-letter market code deciding shipping availability, prices and currency. Defaults to US when omitted or unrecognised. Pass the shopper's own country — prices and stock differ per market.

product_id.description: Product ID to find similar items for (shown as "Product ID: `xxx`" in search results)

name: find_similar
title: Find Similar Products
